amr.rule_detail: Exclude the 24 historical pilot ids. Sort remaining writer groups by name. Assign each whole group to holdout while the holdout count plus that group size is <= 18; otherwise assign the whole group to development.

rxhandbd.train_rule: sha256(image_name) rank, last floor(n/5) rows are internal validation, the rest development. Official test labels are not used to assign this split.
